newsitem.title: GERMANY: German admits paid thugs to bomb foreigners' hostel.
newsitem.headline: German admits paid thugs to bomb foreigners' hostel.

text.p: A German florist has confessed to paying arsonists to firebomb an asylum-seekers' hostel in the tiny east German village of Dolgenbrodt in 1992, the man's lawyer said on Wednesday.

Prosecutors say the man, identified only as Thomas O., paid rightwing thugs 2,000 marks ($1,200) to do the deed and, if caught, keep quiet about who had commissioned the attack carried out the day before 86 asylum-seekers were due to move in.

They have arrested four residents as suspects in the case that has thrown back into the spotlight the village of 260 people south of Berlin, where press reports earlier suggested a widespread conspiracy.
But, according to lawyer Robert Unger, his client Thomas O. said no one else was involved.
A young right-winger was convicted last year of starting the fire but no connection was proved to inhabitants of the village, where many Berliners have weekend retreats.
Although no one was injured, the fire caused 300,000 marks in damage.
Thomas O. is one of two men prosecutors accuse of employing right-wing thugs to carry out the attack during a wave of racist and neo-Nazi violence after German unification.
A man identified as Hans S. and his stepson, "Marco S.", have been arrested on suspicion of providing the firebombs.
